title: prefab
text: Theme: ordered list steps, composed via + step_file(source, dest, strategy = "overwrite", data = NULL): deploy file merge strategy step_text(content, dest, strategy = "overwrite"): deploy inline text content merge strategy step_run(fn, ..., .label = NULL): execute R function Source helpers: from_package(package) from_dir(path) return step-builders Merge strategies: "overwrite", "skip", "union", "append", "merge_json" Template rendering: data = list(...) enables {{var}} interpolation via glue

title: prefab
text: step_file(source, dest, strategy = "overwrite", data = NULL) — create file deployment step step_text(content, dest, strategy = "overwrite") — create inline text deployment step step_run(fn, ..., .label = NULL) — create function execution step from_package(package) — return step-builder function(source, dest, strategy = "overwrite", data = NULL) resolves source paths package (installed loaded via devtools::load_all()) from_dir(path) — return step-builder function(source, dest, strategy = "overwrite", data = NULL) resolves source paths local directory new_theme(...) — construct theme step objects theme_from_dir(path, strategy = "skip") — create theme directory tree, optional _prefab.yml sidecar use_theme(theme) — apply theme current project create_project(path, theme, open = rlang::is_interactive()) — create directory apply theme; open TRUE, activate project (new session/window RStudio/Positron, else setwd() fallback), following usethis proj_activate() pattern launch_project(theme, root, date = FALSE, slug, open, label = NULL) — interactive project launcher intended bound editor key chord via workbench.action.executeCode.console. theme required (default), chord names theme applies. Prompts name via rstudioapi::showPrompt() (guarded hasFun()), builds path via internal build_project_path(), calls create_project(). root defaults option prefab.project_root (~), slug option prefab.project_slug (TRUE); date = TRUE nests YYYY-MM-DD subdirectory. label sets prompt window title (default "New project folder") show theme chord applies (theme objects don’t retain constructor names, label passed caller) theme_code(theme) — print R code reproduces theme (copy-paste customization) load_themes(file = NULL) — source custom theme definitions file (PREFAB_THEMES env var ~/.prefab-themes.R)

title: Getting started with prefab
text: Every file step declares strategy handling pre-existing destination files. Strategies make use_theme() safe re-run. Guidelines choosing: Files user never edit: "overwrite". Files user customize first deploy: "skip". Line-based config entries accumulate: "union". Structured JSON config: "merge_json" (objects merge key--key, arrays union-merged, scalar collisions preserve destination value). Avoid "append" unless want duplicate content re-runs.

title: prefab 0.5.0
text: New launch_project() interactive project launcher designed bound editor keyboard shortcut: prompts name via rstudioapi::showPrompt(), builds path configurable root (home directory default, slugifying name), scaffolds opens project chosen theme. Set date = TRUE dated one-projects (e.g. ~/scratchpad/2026-07-23/name). create_project() gains open argument (default rlang::is_interactive()) controlling whether new project activated; follows usethis patterns fixes VS Code specific bugs. small tweaks r_targets() claude_r_package() themes

title: prefab 0.2.0
text: New theme_from_dir() creates theme directory template files, optional _prefab.yml sidecar per-file strategy template data control. New load_themes() sources custom theme definitions file, support PREFAB_THEMES environment variable ~/.prefab-themes.R default. step_file() now accepts data = "auto" clearer alternative data = list() enabling auto-context template rendering. claude_r_analysis() claude_r_targets() gain settings_json argument optionally skip deploying settings.json. Updated bundled settings.json make air formatter hook conditional air installed. Updated bundled r_analysis.md guidance column-wise operations naming intermediate objects.
